text_block_list.text: The new year. Dantsu Flame was set to participate in the New Year Ekiden Relay hosted by the shopping district!

"They said the ekiden relay was strictly for recreation, but...
Since we were free, we rushed over to cheer them on."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... Happy New Year!
I'm Dantsu Flame,
from Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A friend invited me and it sounded fun, so I decided to join in. Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Team Member
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to working with you~!
This ekiden has a special rule: 8 runners per team, mixing everyday men and women with Umamusume from both inside and outside Tracen Academy.

Furthermore, team assignments are decided by lottery,
and teammates will amazingly meet each other
for the very first time on the day of the event.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
That makes everyone for Team D!
Shall we head to the field for now?

text_block_list.name: Team Member
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you very much.
I'll do my best to win today!
"From a quick look at the pamphlet, the first half has a lot of steep ups and downs, with Section 4 featuring an especially long uphill climb."

On the other hand, Sections 5 through 7 are relatively flat and short.
It feels like the first half and the anchor will be stacked with Tracen students and Umamusume, while the rest are general participants. However—

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
We're out of time, so let's quickly decide the sections!
Anyone want to run a specific one?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, since I'm used to running it,
if no one else is taking it, should I take Section 4?

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait! I know Dantsu Flame-chan
is the best fit for this, but still!

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I made a promise with my rival from the track team. We promised to face off in section 4!
So, would it be okay if I ran?

text_block_list.name: Team Member B
text_block_list.text: S-Speaking of which, could I be the anchor runner?! My grandma who's in the hospital came to watch today...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I see.
Today, it feels less like everyone wants to win and more like they want to challenge themselves.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then of course!
I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
"...Since it's such a rare opportunity,
we'll prioritize the sections everyone wants to run this time!"

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
The only one left is Section 5!
And... the one who hasn't decided yet isâ

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's me!

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Dants-chan in section 5!?
It's a flat, short, pretty easy route though.
Um... are you sure you're okay with that?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Please let me support
everyone's determination!

In the end, I was tasked with taking whatever slot was leftover.
...And so, the day of the real thing arrived.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, Team D!
They're trailing quite far behind the lead pack,
and the sash is handed over to Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...!
S-Sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Nope, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an active Umamusume!
Her speed is on a whole different level~!

text_block_list.name: Team Member
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Dants-chan!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame brilliantly closed the seemingly hopeless gap,
surging ahead until the lead pack was in sight! However—

text_block_list.name: Team Member C
text_block_list.text:
Alright, thanks Dantsu-chan!
Here I go~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...!
Right, let's keep fighting!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I really wanted to catch up to the lead pack, though.
It looks like all the anchors are Umamusume, so...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Team D is trailing far behind—
and they finally cross the finish line in last place!!

text_block_list.name: Team Member B
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!! I-I'm so sorry, it's because I insisted on running the anchor leg...!

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text: I mean, my Section 4! I really should've let Dantsu-chan run it after all...

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: Still, everyone had great looks on their faces! Results aren't everything, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for your support today!
I'm sorry I couldn't win, though~."
choice_data_list: No, no, you were really doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm sorry!
Did I have a gloomy look on my face? Oh dear.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
I was just thinking about how too bad that ekiden was, you know?

"Normally, we were scheduled to train after this,
but with her spirits so low,
her heart wouldn't be in it."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go get a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, ...what!?
And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *chew*...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...!? Mm, this! This right here!
This cake is super delicious!
Do you want half!?
choice_data_list: No, no, if it's delicious then eat it all

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Still, it's a New Year's special, after all...! Ah, could it be you don't like it?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see. Grown-ups don't really
split their food in half... do they?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I just, um...
I wanted you to try some too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, on second thought, mind if I have some?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of the game center...
There's one I've been wanting to try!

"Alright, here we go!
First, the Happy New Year pose!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hup!
Come on, Trainer, say "Happy New Year!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I saw it on Umastagram~.
Apparently there's a New Year's exclusive mode,
though I don't know the details—
""I bought a lucky bag~! Strike a pose♪""

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There's even something like this...!
Ahaha, how interesting!

"Lastly, press your cheeks together~!
Mochi-mochi~!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!? M-My cheek!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Cheeks~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah... are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah, so many people! It really feels like New Year's~!

text_block_list.name: Dants's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dantsu! Great timing~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Whoa, you startled me.
Happy New Year...? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Dants's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year, Happy New Year! Hey, sorry to ask,
but could you give me a quick hand?
There's super crazy stuff going on and I need all the help I can get right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
B-By yourself!? That sounds really tough...!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ...But really, I'm sorry.
I just came to hang out with my Trainer today.
So—
choice_data_list: Shall the two of us help out?

text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!
—An amulet for "Family Safety", was it?
Yes, right this way, please.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I came for the memorial burning.
...Are you busy right now?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... welcome to our shrine.
If you could please wait just a moment—
choice_data_list: Let me show you the way. This way, please.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...!
Thank you, Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I think I can head home in good spirits.
...It's all thanks to you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um. The reason I was feeling down
wasn't actually because we lost the ekiden.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, well, it is because I lost, but, um, strictly speaking, that's not quite it, or should I say, um—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...When we were deciding the running order, the truth is,
I was hoping to take the 4th leg or be the anchor.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd have a better chance of winning that way, so...
But in the end, I just backed off and gave way right away.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder, if I had spoken up back then,
even if we lost,
maybe no one would have had as many regrets."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel so terrible...
It's because I tried to... overread the room.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I might have been considerate of everyone's desire to run, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I ended up
ruining that desire to win.

I remember the unease I felt late last year
regarding Dants Flame's habit of holding back her opinions.
I wasn't confident enough to point it out back then, but—

Looking at how things went today, as expected...
if anything, it was a hurdle she had to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry! Even though it's already in the past...
It's troubling when I bring up stuff like this, isn't it?
choice_data_list: No, ...let's talk properly about that tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: There's something I need to tell you too.
There's something I need to tell you too.

text_block_list.text: With that promise made, they welcomed the new year.
